embeddings.text: Appliances are covered for 36 months from the delivery date shown on the invoice.
Claims filed after the coverage period are rejected.
Damage caused by improper installation, power surges without a certified surge protector, or heavy or commercial use voids the coverage.
Repairs with an estimated cost above 1,500 ILS are referred to a service supervisor.
An appliance that fails a third time within the coverage period is replaced; replacements require supervisor approval.
Coverage for refurbished appliances is 12 months.
Claims that meet the conditions above are approved for repair. Anything not decided is referred to the service desk.

R-010 · Months since delivery
When: always
Then: set months_since_delivery = months_between(delivery_date, claim_date)
Source, paragraph 1: "Appliances are covered for 36 months from the delivery date shown on the invoice"

R-100 · Reject: claim after 36 months
When: months_since_delivery > 36 months
Then: reject: The claim was filed after the 36-month coverage period
Source, paragraph 2: "Claims filed after the coverage period are rejected"

R-110 · Reject: excluded causes
When: improper_installation = true OR surge_without_protector = true OR commercial_use = true
Then: reject: Improper installation, unprotected power surges or commercial use void the coverage
Source, paragraph 3: "Damage caused by improper installation, power surges without a certified surge protector, or heavy or commercial use voids the coverage"

R-300 · Supervisor: estimated cost above 1,500
When: estimated_cost > 1,500 ILS
Then: refer: Repairs above 1,500 ILS are referred to a service supervisor
Source, paragraph 4: "Repairs with an estimated cost above 1,500 ILS are referred to a service supervisor"

R-310 · Supervisor: third failure, replacement
When: failure_count ≥ 3
Then: refer: A third failure within coverage is replaced with supervisor approval
Source, paragraph 5: "An appliance that fails a third time within the coverage period is replaced; replacements require supervisor approval"

R-900 · Approve for repair
When: always
Then: approve: The claim meets the coverage conditions and is approved for repair
Source, paragraph 7: "Claims that meet the conditions above are approved for repair"
